lines.zh: 我不走路，我是滑过墓土的。
lines.en: I do not walk. I slide over grave soil.

lines.zh: 墙让开一点，我就过去了。
lines.en: The wall yields an inch and I am through.

lines.zh: 坟土在我脚下松开，像门。
lines.en: Grave dirt loosens beneath me like a door.

lines.zh: 月光照在我身上，穿过去了。
lines.en: Moonlight passes through me without stopping.

lines.zh: 我飘得比你的呼吸还轻。
lines.en: I drift lighter than your breathing.

lines.zh: 脚步声是你的，我早就没有了。
lines.en: Those footsteps are yours. I lost mine long ago.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，全是冷气凝的。
lines.en: Thirty points of life, all of it frozen air.

lines.zh: 我不碰草，草自己弯下去。
lines.en: I do not touch the grass; it bends anyway.

lines.zh: 我在墓园里绕，从碑到碑。
lines.en: I wander the graveyard from stone to stone.

lines.zh: 夜够长，我能走完整片坟地。
lines.en: The night is long enough to cross every grave.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到我脚下。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach beneath me.

lines.zh: 我移动时不带风，只带凉意。
lines.en: I move without wind, only cold.

lines.zh: 我站在坟头，等土再松一次。
lines.en: I stand on a grave, waiting for the soil to loosen.

lines.zh: 亡灵意志不该有不耐烦。
lines.en: A revenant's will should not know impatience.

lines.zh: 我记得棺材里的方向。
lines.en: I still remember which way the coffin lay.

lines.zh: 墓碑上刻的名字模糊了。
lines.en: The name carved on that stone has worn away.

lines.zh: 我数着夜里的虫声。
lines.en: I count the insects crying in the dark.

lines.zh: 白天的光在外面等着我。
lines.en: Daylight is waiting for me outside.

lines.zh: 我的影子留在了土里。
lines.en: My shadow stayed behind in the soil.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，什么也没带走。
lines.en: The wind passes through me and takes nothing.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有人开那只箱子。
lines.en: I am listening for someone opening that chest.

lines.zh: 三秒不动，我就散成一口气。
lines.en: Three still seconds and I thin into vapor.

lines.zh: 活人的热气在你领口绕着。
lines.en: Living warmth still clings around your collar.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的火把，太亮了。
lines.en: I know that torch in your hand. Too bright.

lines.zh: 你踩着坟土，脚底有声音。
lines.en: You step on grave dirt; it makes a sound.

lines.zh: 别回头，我可能就在你影子里。
lines.en: Do not turn around. I may be in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我也在数你的骨头。
lines.en: While you look at me, I count your bones.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm. I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 活人会眨眼，我不会。
lines.en: The living blink. I do not.

lines.zh: 你带了魂质？那是从我身上剥的。
lines.en: You carry ectoplasm? That was peeled from me.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你还认得吗？
lines.en: Do you still recognize this face?

lines.zh: 你站在坟边，影子比我实。
lines.en: You stand by the grave, your shadow more solid than I.

lines.zh: 我的身体散了一下，又聚回来。
lines.en: My body scattered and gathered again.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，凉气漏了出去。
lines.en: Cold air leaked from where you struck.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，掉一点都清楚。
lines.en: Thirty points of life. I feel each one leave.

lines.zh: 这只手臂散了，我重新捏一个。
lines.en: That arm came apart; I shaped another.

lines.zh: 我感觉不到痛，只感觉到少。
lines.en: I feel no pain, only less of me.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的低语。
lines.en: You cut off my whispering.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了土压的重量。
lines.en: That blow reminded me of the weight of soil.

lines.zh: 我退进墙里，让石头替我挡。
lines.en: I sink into the wall and let stone take the blow.

lines.zh: 我的形状晃了晃，像烛火。
lines.en: My shape wavered like a candle flame.

lines.zh: 你伤的是这口气，不是身体。
lines.en: You wounded this breath, not a body.

lines.zh: 食物对我只是一堆会烂的东西。
lines.en: Food is only a pile of things that rot.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，可我没有胃了。
lines.en: You hold out bread, but I have no stomach.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，已经被埋了。
lines.en: The last time I was hungry, I was already buried.

lines.zh: 亡灵不吃东西，只吃安静。
lines.en: The dead eat no food. They eat quiet.

lines.zh: 你的诱饵在发亮，我的眼睛不认光。
lines.en: Your bait glows; my eyes do not count light.

lines.zh: 拿开，那味道让我想起葬礼。
lines.en: Take it away; that smell reminds me of a funeral.

lines.zh: 我曾经也爱吃甜的，现在尝不出。
lines.en: I once liked sweets. Now I taste nothing.

lines.zh: 你在喂一个空壳。
lines.en: You are feeding an empty shell.

lines.zh: 这箱子里的东西，比你的食物香。
lines.en: What is in that chest smells better than your food.

lines.zh: 诱惑活人有用，对我只剩风声。
lines.en: Temptation works on the living. For me, only wind.

lines.zh: 你穿过了我，肩膀凉了一下。
lines.en: You passed through me; your shoulder went cold.

lines.zh: 我不用绕路，你会让开的。
lines.en: I need no detour. You will step aside.

lines.zh: 撞在我身上，像撞进一口凉井。
lines.en: Walking into me is walking into a cold well.

lines.zh: 别靠那么近，你会带走我的冷。
lines.en: Not so close; you will carry my cold away.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有边，你的手摸空了。
lines.en: My body has no edge; your hand closed on nothing.

lines.zh: 你不小心碰到我，我记下了。
lines.en: You touched me by accident. I noted it.

lines.zh: 你后退时踩到了我的坟。
lines.en: Backing away, you stepped on my grave.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，你的牙齿开始打颤。
lines.en: I lean close and your teeth begin to chatter.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，不占多少地方。
lines.en: Thirty points of life take very little room.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，我本来就不实。
lines.en: A bump does not matter. I was never solid.

lines.zh: 坟土里没有婚礼，只有回声。
lines.en: There are no weddings in grave dirt. Only echoes.

lines.zh: 我已经没有能许给谁的东西了。
lines.en: There is nothing left in me to promise anyone.

lines.zh: 你听见的低语，是我想起某个人。
lines.en: That whisper you hear is me remembering someone.

lines.zh: 亡灵不生养，只把名字留在碑上。
lines.en: The dead do not breed; they leave names on stones.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，夜已经够长了。
lines.en: I need no companion. The night is long enough.

lines.zh: 两个幽灵碰在一起，只会更冷。
lines.en: Two ghosts meeting only make it colder.

lines.zh: 我曾答应过谁，如今记不清了。
lines.en: I once promised someone. I cannot recall now.

lines.zh: 别对我唱情歌，我听不见活人的调。
lines.en: Do not sing to me; I cannot hear living tunes.

lines.zh: 我的戒指还在土里，取不出来。
lines.en: My ring is still in the soil. I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 你走吧，这种热闹不属于坟地。
lines.en: Go on; such warmth does not belong in a graveyard.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，手会穿过去。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my hand passes through.

lines.zh: 那块魂质本来是我的。
lines.en: That ectoplasm was mine to begin with.

lines.zh: 你把灵锭收好，别在我面前晃。
lines.en: Put that spirit ingot away. Do not wave it at me.

lines.zh: 我只拿得动冷气，别的都漏了。
lines.en: I can only hold cold air; the rest slips through.

lines.zh: 东西掉在坟土上，就归土了。
lines.en: Drop something in grave dirt and it belongs to the soil.

lines.zh: 我低头看你的掉落物，没有伸手。
lines.en: I look down at your dropped item. I do not reach.

lines.zh: 这箱子里的东西，你最好别碰。
lines.en: The things in this chest are best left alone.

lines.zh: 我的指节从剑柄里穿过去了。
lines.en: My knuckles passed through the sword hilt.

lines.zh: 灵锭只有一小块，值一条命。
lines.en: One small spirit ingot. Worth a life.

lines.zh: 你捡走的是灰，我留下的是位置。
lines.en: You take the ash; I keep the place it lay.

lines.zh: 你的火光把我的坟照醒了。
lines.en: Your torchlight woke the grave I sleep in.

lines.zh: 你是活人，这就够了。
lines.en: You are alive. That is enough.

lines.zh: 走进墓园的人，归我管。
lines.en: Anyone who walks into this graveyard answers to me.

lines.zh: 我听见你开箱子的声音了。
lines.en: I heard the chest lid creak open.

lines.zh: 白天我杀不了你，夜里可以。
lines.en: By daylight I cannot kill you. At night I can.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你还没跑。
lines.en: I counted three. You are still here.

lines.zh: 你身上有灵锭的味道。
lines.en: You smell of spirit ingot.

lines.zh: 先绕你一圈，找没有护甲的地方。
lines.en: First a circle, to find where your armor ends.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我坟上，很好。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my grave. Good.

lines.zh: 我不追活人，我追你的呼吸。
lines.en: I do not chase the living. I chase your breath.

lines.zh: 这一夜，墓园只留一个活物。
lines.en: Tonight this graveyard keeps one living thing.

lines.zh: 你的武器挡不住穿墙的东西。
lines.en: Your weapon cannot stop what walks through walls.

lines.zh: 我闻到了坟土的近亲，你挖过墓。
lines.en: You smell of grave dirt. You have dug before.

lines.zh: 我记得你的脸了，跑也没用。
lines.en: I have your face memorized. Running will not help.

lines.zh: 你踩上坟土那一刻，我就醒了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped on grave soil, I woke.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，让你转不过来。
lines.en: I circle you in flight until you cannot turn fast enough.

lines.zh: 再等一息，我就要叫了。
lines.en: One more breath and I will scream.

lines.zh: 你背对着墙，这很好。
lines.en: Your back is to the wall. Good.

lines.zh: 我穿过这块石头，从你后面出来。
lines.en: I pass through this stone and come out behind you.

lines.zh: 箭矢会穿过去，别浪费。
lines.en: Arrows pass through me. Do not waste them.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得太高，脚下是空的。
lines.en: Your shield is high; your feet are wide open.

lines.zh: 尖啸之前，我先吸气。
lines.en: Before the shriek, I draw a breath I do not need.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，你看不见我。
lines.en: I skim the ground where your eyes do not go.

lines.zh: 火对我无效，你举着火把做什么？
lines.en: Fire does nothing to me. Why raise that torch?

lines.zh: 你退到阳光下？那我也死不了。
lines.en: Retreat into sunlight? Even there I will not die.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚离开石阶。
lines.en: I am waiting for your foot to leave that step.

lines.zh: 你转身的速度，比我飘得慢。
lines.en: You turn slower than I drift.

lines.zh: 我的尖啸会先到，身体随后。
lines.en: My shriek arrives first. My body follows.

lines.zh: 你越急，我绕的圈越小。
lines.en: The more you panic, the tighter my circles.

lines.zh: 我飘到你影子里，那里最暖。
lines.en: I drift into your shadow; it is warmest there.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到我这一侧。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach my side.

lines.zh: 我退半步，好让你以为能跑。
lines.en: I back half a step so you think you can run.

lines.zh: 你在找我的身体，我就在你眼前。
lines.en: You search for my body. It is right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的胸口，凉得像冰。
lines.en: I slam into your chest, cold as ice.

lines.zh: 尖啸贴着你的耳边炸开。
lines.en: The shriek bursts right beside your ear.

lines.zh: 我的指节从你肩头穿过。
lines.en: My knuckles pass through your shoulder.

lines.zh: 三点的伤害，够你记住冷。
lines.en: Three points of damage. Enough to remember cold.

lines.zh: 你被我一推，后退了两步。
lines.en: One shove from me and you stagger two steps.

lines.zh: 我抓住你，你却抓不住我。
lines.en: I catch hold of you; you cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把你的火把撞灭了。
lines.en: That charge knocked your torch out.

lines.zh: 我从正面冲，你等着就好。
lines.en: I charge straight on. Just stand and wait.

lines.zh: 盔甲接住了这一撞，也接了凉气。
lines.en: Your armor stopped the charge but not the chill.

lines.zh: 冷气钻进你的领口。
lines.en: Cold air crawls down your collar.

lines.zh: 我穿过你，再回来一次。
lines.en: I pass through you, then come back for more.

lines.zh: 你挥剑砍空了，我笑了一声。
lines.en: Your sword hit nothing; I laughed once.

lines.zh: 抓不到实体，你就打不赢。
lines.en: You cannot hit what has no body.

lines.zh: 这一下留手了，我在试你怕不怕冷。
lines.en: That one was light; I was testing your fear of cold.

lines.zh: 我的手伸进你胸口，什么也没抓住。
lines.en: My hand passes through your chest and grips nothing.

lines.zh: 尖啸过后，你的耳朵先出血。
lines.en: After the scream, your ears bleed first.

lines.zh: 坟土翻开，我先伸出的是手。
lines.en: The grave dirt parts; my hand comes out first.

lines.zh: 夜里，墓园第三块碑下有人在动。
lines.en: At night, something moves under the third stone.

lines.zh: 你打开那只箱子，我就来了。
lines.en: You opened that chest, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我被埋了很久，冷已经住进骨头。
lines.en: Buried so long the cold moved into my bones.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，从土里站起来。
lines.en: Thirty points of life rise out of the soil.

lines.zh: 月光落下来，我才敢成形。
lines.en: Only when moonlight falls do I take shape.

lines.zh: 亡灵意志，不需要再呼吸。
lines.en: A revenant's will needs no more breathing.

lines.zh: 我爬出来时，草叶都结了霜。
lines.en: When I climbed out, frost covered the grass.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有重量，也没有影子。
lines.en: This body has no weight and casts no shadow.

lines.zh: 白天我会站在这里，谁也伤不了我。
lines.en: By day I stand here, and nothing can hurt me.

lines.zh: 我认得这座墓园，每一块石头。
lines.en: I know this graveyard, every single stone.

lines.zh: 有人动了坟土，我就醒了。
lines.en: Someone disturbed the grave soil, so I woke.

lines.zh: 我从棺材里坐起，木头早就烂了。
lines.en: I sit up in the coffin; the wood rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 诅咒的箱子一响，我的名字就被叫了。
lines.en: The cursed chest clicked, and my name was called.

lines.zh: 火焰穿过去，什么也没烧到。
lines.en: The flame passed through and burned nothing.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，落下去也是飘的。
lines.en: I have no weight; falling for me is drifting.

lines.zh: 水淹不到一个不呼吸的东西。
lines.en: Water cannot drown something that never breathes.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹散，我慢慢合上。
lines.en: The blast blew me apart; I slowly closed up.

lines.zh: 箭从我心里穿出去，钉在墙上。
lines.en: The arrow went through my chest and stuck in the wall.

lines.zh: 咒语想捆住我，抓不住雾。
lines.en: The spell tried to bind me and caught mist.

lines.zh: 我早就忘了饿是什么。
lines.en: I forgot what hunger was long ago.

lines.zh: 雷电打穿我，只让我更亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning pierced me and made me brighter for a moment.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我和黑暗分不清了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I blend with the dark.
